title: Index mean reversion after opening range extension
thesis: Equity index futures may mean-revert after an opening range extension when volume fades and price fails to hold beyond the range.
market_intuition: Failed opening range breakouts may create short-lived reversal opportunities when participation fades after the first hour.
entry_idea: Enter against the failed extension after a close back inside the opening range.
exit_idea: Exit at midpoint, opposite range boundary, fixed stop, or end of day.
risk_assumption: Stop beyond the failed extension high/low with fixed dollar risk.
cost_slippage_assumption: Include futures commissions and at least one tick slippage per side.
data_source: Futures OHLCV with regular session labels.
disproof_condition: Reject if reversals only work on news days or fail after one tick extra slippage.

clarification_answers.q_news: Exclude scheduled FOMC and CPI releases in the first experiment.
